doc: Project-owned npm supply-chain policy for pulse-app/ui, evaluated by `cargo xtask check:npm-supply-chain` (xtask/src/npm_gate.rs). Advisory exceptions are GHSA-id-scoped; license exceptions are package-scoped; both carry provenance and a closing condition and are PRUNED once the condition fires (security-plan §Dependency Security: a finding with a stated safe forward upgrade is never excepted — it stays red until upgraded). License source is package-lock.json license fields (906/909 coverage measured 2026-08-30); class split rides the lockfile dev flags: runtime = prod-reachable (Vite-bundled into the shipped webview), dev = harness/build-only.

advisory_exceptions.reason: no fixed version exists — the advisory's vulnerable range is '*'; reached via puppeteer/@puppeteer/browsers under webdriverio 9 and under pa11y-ci 4.1.1 (latest), which internally nests pa11y 9 although the top-level pa11y is 10. Dev/harness-only chains, no runtime or bundle path.
advisory_exceptions.closing_condition: upstream publishes a fixed extract-zip (or the advisory range narrows) and the puppeteer chains move onto it, or both consuming chains (webdriverio, pa11y-ci) drop extract-zip; prune when the gate runs green without this entry

advisory_exceptions.reason: no fixed version exists — the advisory's vulnerable range is '*' and 2.0.1 (unchanged since 2023) is the latest release; npm's suggested remediation is a major DOWNGRADE of pa11y-ci to 3.1.0, rejected. Same chains as GHSA-jmr9-qjv8-65gv: puppeteer/@puppeteer/browsers under webdriverio 9 and pa11y-ci 4. Dev/harness-only, no runtime or bundle path.
advisory_exceptions.closing_condition: upstream publishes a fixed extract-zip (or the advisory range narrows) and the puppeteer chains move onto it, or both consuming chains (webdriverio, pa11y-ci) drop extract-zip; prune when the gate runs green without this entry
